title: Machine learning, WGCNA and molecular docking identify SLC transporter genes as biomarkers and drug targets in Helicobacter pylori-associated carcinogenesis.
authors: Lv, Nuonan; He, Xue; Cai, Ting; Xu, Yingting; Xie, Jie; Zhao, Xuelin; Yang, Binfang; Liu, Xuemei; Zhang, Minglin
one_liner_zh: 该研究用机器学习、WGCNA和分子对接识别幽门螺杆菌相关胃癌中的SLC转运蛋白基因作为生物标志物和药物靶点，虽涉及分子对接但对象为转运蛋白而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合建模，仅预测转录因子作为上游调控因子，与本课题核心关联弱。
abstract: Solute carrier (SLC) family genes govern transmembrane transport and cellular metabolism, yet their systematic roles from Helicobacter pylori infection to gastric cancer (GC) remain undefined. By integrating multiple GEO datasets with weighted gene co-expression network analysis, differential expression, and machine learning algorithms, we identified seven core SLC genes (SLC9A9, SLC43A2, SLC16A6, SLC7A14, SLC28A3, SLC4A11, SLC5A2) for H. pylori infection and nine (SLC1A3, SLC2A3, SLC15A3, SLC19A3, SLC2A12, SLC16A4, SLC25A4, SLC9A7, SLC28A3) for GC. Logistic regression models achieved high diagnostic accuracy (AUC = 0.976 and 0.874, respectively). Immune infiltration analysis revealed distinct correlation patterns: SLC4A11 and SLC5A2 associated with activated mast cells, neutrophils, and M2 macrophages in infection, while SLC1A3 and SLC2A3 correlated broadly with M1/M2 macrophages and activated CD4(+) T cells in GC. Enrichment analyses confirmed involvement in transmembrane transport, immune-related pathways, and cancer signaling. Transcription factor prediction identified CEBPB, RELB, and STAT5A as key upstream regulators. Molecular docking demonstrated strong binding affinities between SLC proteins and repurposable compounds (3'-azido-3'-deoxythymidine, CHEMBL1182312, quinine). This study provides the first systematic characterization of SLC family expression across the H. pylori-GC continuum, identifying potential diagnostic biomarkers and therapeutic targets that warrant further experimental validation.
abstract_zh: 溶质载体（SLC）家族基因调控跨膜转运和细胞代谢，然而它们在从幽门螺杆菌感染到胃癌（GC）过程中的系统性作用仍未明确。通过整合多个GEO数据集与加权基因共表达网络分析、差异表达和机器学习算法，我们针对幽门螺杆菌感染鉴定了七个核心SLC基因（SLC9A9、SLC43A2、SLC16A6、SLC7A14、SLC28A3、SLC4A11、SLC5A2），针对胃癌鉴定了九个（SLC1A3、SLC2A3、SLC15A3、SLC19A3、SLC2A12、SLC16A4、SLC25A4、SLC9A7、SLC28A3）。逻辑回归模型实现了高诊断准确性（AUC分别为0.976和0.874）。免疫浸润分析揭示了不同的相关性模式：SLC4A11和SLC5A2与感染中活化的肥大细胞、中性粒细胞和M2巨噬细胞相关，而SLC1A3和SLC2A3在胃癌中与M1/M2巨噬细胞和活化的CD4(+) T细胞广泛相关。富集分析确认了其在跨膜转运、免疫相关通路和癌症信号传导中的参与。转录因子预测识别出CEBPB、RELB和STAT5A为关键上游调控因子。分子对接展示了SLC蛋白与可再利用化合物（3'-叠氮-3'-脱氧胸苷、CHEMBL1182312、奎宁）之间的强结合亲和力。本研究首次系统表征了SLC家族在幽门螺杆菌-胃癌连续过程中的表达，识别出潜在的诊断生物标志物和治疗靶点，有待进一步实验验证。
